information:
# Note: This is 3x3x3 Fewest Moves Only competition. 

Welcome to Malaysia FMC Championship 2025! As FMC is not being held at [Malaysia Cube Championship 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MalaysiaCubeChampionship2025), this is your chance to become the Malaysia's Fewest Moves Champion! The competition will be held in Kuala Lumpur, Johor Bahru and Penang. Please check select the [location](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MalaysiaFMCChampionship2025#66171-location) you wish to join FMC when you make the payment. 

**3x3x3 Fewest Moves event** (**this may not be recommended for new competitor**). 

For those who are interested in joining **Please Be Quiet Kuala Lumpur 2025** can register through [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PBQKualaLumpur2025) /  **Please Be Quiet Johor 2025** can register through [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PleaseBeQuietJohor2025). The event will take place at the same venue before this competition.

#### After the completion of your registration, please send us an email regarding which location that you wish to join, so we can estimate the turnout for each location.

[![Malaysia Cube Association(MYCSA)](https://imgur.com/ZUv6wZJ.jpg)](https://www.mycubeassociation.org/Competition/Info/MalaysiaFMCChampionship2025)
